title: Salvadoran man dies in ICE custody at New Jersey detention centre
english: Edwin Lopez-Cornejo, a 41-year-old Salvadoran man, recently passed away after suffering a medical emergency at the Delaney Hall detention center in New Jersey. His family and advocates claim he was denied necessary medication for his existing health conditions, though ICE asserts he received appropriate care. This incident, marking the second death at the facility in under a year, has led to public protests and renewed calls for the center to be closed.
amharic: ኤድዊን ሎፔዝ-ኮርኔጆ የተባሉ የ41 ዓመት የሳልቫዶር ተወላጅ በኒው ጀርሲ በሚገኘው የዴላኒ ሆል እስር ቤት በህክምና ድንገተኛ አደጋ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ቤተሰቦቻቸው እና የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ለነበረባቸው የጤና እክል አስፈላጊውን መድሃኒት እንዳያገኙ ተደርገዋል በማለት የከሰሱ ሲሆን፣ የኢሚግሬሽን እና የጉምሩክ ማስፈጸሚያ ኤጀንሲ (ICE) ግን ተገቢውን ህክምና እንደተደረገላቸው ይናገራል። በአንድ ዓመት ጊዜ ውስጥ በተመሳሳይ እስር ቤት የሁለተኛው ሰው ህልፈት በመከሰቱ፣ ተቋሙ እንዲዘጋ የተቃውሞ ሰልፎች እየተካሄዱ ይገኛል።
oromo: Edwiin Looppez-Koorneeyoo kan jedhaman umriin isaanii waggaa 41 kan ta’e lammii Saalvaadoor, buufata qabii godaantotaa Deelaanii Haal kan Niiw Jeersii jiru keessatti rakkoo fayyaa mudateen du’aniiru. Maatiin isaanii fi gartuuwwan mirga namoomaa dhimmoota fayyaa isaan qaban irratti qorichi barbaachisu akka isaanitti hin geenye dubbatanis, qaamni ICE garuu walqixxummaa fi qulqullina qabuun yaalii akka godhameef hima. Golee kana keessatti waggaa tokko hin guunne keessatti lubbuun namoota lama darbuun isaa mormii uumee fi buufatichi akka cufamu gaaffiin akka ka’u taasiseera.

title: US stocks near record high, oil falls as Trump claims Iran talks under way
english: US stock markets saw a significant rally, with the Dow Jones reaching a new record high despite uncertainty regarding potential peace negotiations with Iran. While tech stocks led the market surge, oil prices dropped following claims by President Trump that talks between Washington and Tehran are underway. Investors remain cautious as the US and Iran offer conflicting reports about the current status of these diplomatic discussions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የአክሲዮን ገበያ ከኢራን ጋር እየተደረገ ስላለው የሰላም ድርድር ባለው እርግጠኛ አለመሆን መሀል ከፍተኛ ጭማሪ አሳይቷል፣ በተለይም የዶው ጆንስ መረጃ ጠቋሚ አዲስ ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግቧል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በዋሽንግተን እና በቴህራን መካከል ድርድር እየተካሄደ ነው ማለታቸውን ተከትሎ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ቀንሷል። ነገር ግን ሁለቱ ሀገራት ስለ ድርድሩ ሁኔታ የሚሰጡት መረጃ የሚጋጭ በመሆኑ ባለሀብቶች በጥንቃቄ እየተከታተሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gabaan aksiyoonaa Ameerikaa marii nagaa Iran waliin taasifamu irratti shakkiin jiraatuus, guddina olaanaa galmeessiseera; keessattuu Dow Jones rekodii haaraa qabateera. Preezdaant Traamp mariin gidduu Waashingitan fi Tehraanitti adeemsifamaa jiraachuu dubbachuun isaanii gatiin boba'aa akka hir'atu godheera. Haata'u malee, biyyoonni lameen waa'ee haala mariichaa gabaasa walfaallessu kennuun isaanii investaroonni akka of eeggannoon socho'an taasiseera.

title: Ibrahim Traore: Why Burkina Faso’s popular leader faces a reality test
english: Captain Ibrahim Traore, who seized power in Burkina Faso's 2022 coup, has gained fame across Africa for his stance on sovereignty and anti-imperialism. While he remains popular for his efforts to reduce foreign influence and promote self-reliance, his administration faces criticism for restricting political freedoms and failing to resolve the nation's ongoing security crisis. His decision to delay a return to democracy has raised concerns about the long-term impact of his military-led government on the country.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2022 በተካሄደው መፈንቅለ መንግስት ስልጣን የያዙት ካፒቴን ኢብራሂም ትራኦሬ በሉዓላዊነት እና በፀረ-ኢምፔሪያሊዝም አቋማቸው በመላው አፍሪካ ተወዳጅነትን አትርፈዋል። የውጭ ተፅእኖን በመቀነስ እና የሀገር ውስጥ አቅምን በማጎልበት ረገድ ድጋፍ ቢኖራቸውም፣ መንግስታቸው የፖለቲካ ነፃነትን በመገደቡ እና የሀገሪቱን የጸጥታ ችግር መፍታት ባለመቻሉ እየተተቸ ነው። ወደ ዴሞክራሲያዊ ስርአት የሚደረገውን ሽግግር ማራዘማቸውም በመንግስታቸው የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታ ላይ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Kapiteen Ibraahim Traoree bara 2022 fonqolcha mootummaan aangoo kan qabatan yoo ta'u, waa'ee birmadummaa fi farra impaayeralizimii irratti qaban irratti hundaa'uun Afrikaa keessatti beekamtii argataniiru. Dhiibbaa alaa hir'isuuf yaalii godhaniin hordoftoota hedduu horatanis, mootummaan isaanii mirga siyaasaa daangessuu fi nageenya biyyattii mirkaneessuu dhabuun isaanii qeeqa irratti baneera. gara sirna dimokiraasii deebi'uu dabarsuun isaanii immoo gara fuulduraatti mootummaan waraanaa kun biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa akkamii akka qabaatu yaaddoo uumera.

title: Does the US blockade on Cuba make America safer?
english: The Trump administration has tightened economic restrictions on Cuba, justifying the move by labeling the country a persistent threat to U.S. national security. While the blockade remains controversial, some policy experts argue that Cuba’s highly capable intelligence services pose a legitimate risk to American interests. The administration continues to defend these escalated sanctions as a necessary measure for national protection.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ኩባ ለብሄራዊ ደህንነታቸው ስጋት እንደሆነች በመግለጽ በሀገሪቱ ላይ የጣለውን የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ አጠናክሯል። አንዳንድ የፖሊሲ አማካሪዎች የኩባ የስለላ ተቋም ከፍተኛ አቅም ያለው በመሆኑ ለአሜሪካ ስጋት መሆኑን ይስማማሉ። መንግስት ይህንን ማዕቀብ ሀገሪቱን ለመከላከል አስፈላጊ እርምጃ እንደሆነ ይገልጻል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa biyyi Kuubaa nageenya biyyattiitiif sodaadha jechuun daangaa dinagdee irratti kaa'ame cimseera. Hayyoonni siyaasaa tokko tokko akka jedhanitti, tajaajilli odeeffannoo Kuubaa humna cimaa qabaachuun isaa Ameerikaaf yaaddoo ta'uu mala. Mootummaan tarkaanfii kana nageenya biyyaa eeguuf kan barbaachisuudha jedha.

title: Board of Peace says no Israeli withdrawal from Gaza before Hamas disarms
english: The U.S.-led Board of Peace has clarified that Israeli forces will not withdraw from Gaza until Hamas fully disarms, including the removal of all weapons and tunnels. Despite ongoing talks, Israeli officials have expressed dissatisfaction with the terms of the deal, while Hamas maintains that the agreement depends on Israel meeting its own obligations. Meanwhile, violence continues in the region, with reports of recent casualties despite previously established ceasefire efforts.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የሚመራው የሰላም ቦርድ የጋዛን አካባቢ ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ እስካልፈታ ድረስ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ከጋዛ እንደማይወጡ አስታውቋል። የቦርዱ ዳይሬክተር ኒኮላይ ምላዴኖቭ ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ ጋር ከተወያዩ በኋላ፣ የሃማስ የጦር መሳሪያዎች እና ዋሻዎች ሙሉ በሙሉ እስኪወገዱ ድረስ መውጣቱ እንደማይከናወን ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል ሀማስ ስምምነቱ ተግባራዊ የሚሆነው እስራኤል የገቡትን ቃል ሲፈጽሙ ብቻ እንደሆነ አቋሙን ይዟል።
oromo: Boordiin Nageenyaa kan Ameerikaan durfamu, humnoonni Israa'el hamma dhaabbanni Hamaas meeshaa waraanaa guutuu hiikkatuufi tunnela isaa diiguutti, Gaza keessaa akka hin baane ibseera. Qajeelchi boordichaa Nikoolay Mlaadeenoov pirezidaant Binyaamiin Netaanyaahuu waliin mari'achuu isaanii hordofee, kaayyoon inni guddaan bulchiinsa sivilii uumuu akka ta'e beeksise. Gama biraatiin, Hamaas waliigalteen kun kan hojiirra oolu Israa'el dirqama ishee yoo baatte qofa akka ta'e ibsee jira.

title: Report: Pentagon is emailing military experts and asking best way to 'punish' Iran
english: The U.S. military is actively seeking advice from external experts to develop new strategies for pressuring Iran. This initiative, revealed through internal communications, suggests that the Pentagon is struggling to find a resolution to the ongoing tensions. While officials claim such inquiries are routine, the effort highlights the administration's difficulty in achieving its desired diplomatic goals with Tehran.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ መሥሪያ ቤት በኢራን ላይ ጫና የሚፈጥሩባቸውን አዳዲስ መንገዶች ለመቀየስ ከውጭ ባለሙያዎች ምክር እየጠየቀ ይገኛል። በወጡ መረጃዎች መሰረት፣ ፔንታጎን አሁን ያለውን የኢራን ውጥረት ለመፍታት አዳጋች እንደሆነበት ይታያል። ምንም እንኳን ባለስልጣናት ይህ የተለመደ አሰራር ነው ቢሉም፣ ድርጊቱ አስተዳደሩ ከኢራን ጋር የፈለገውን ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ እየተቸገረ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Ameerikaa dhiibbaa Iran irratti uumuuf mala haaraa barbaadaa jiraachuu gabaasni tokko ifa godheera. Pentagonin rakkoo Iran wajjiin jiru furuuf gargaarsa ogeeyyota alaa gaafachuun isaa, mootummaan Trump rakkoo kana keessaa ba'uuf akka dhiphachaa jiru mul'isa. Qondaaltonni tarkaanfichi kan barame dha jedhanii ibsanis, kun ammoo Ameerikaan fedhii ishee Iran biratti guuttachuuf akka rakkachaa jirtu agarsiisa.

title: UKMTO says tank struck off Oman's coast
english: A cargo ship was hit by an unidentified object while traveling near the coast of Oman in the Strait of Hormuz. The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations reported that the incident occurred approximately 20 nautical miles from Al Khasab. Authorities are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding the strike on the vessel.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ የሚጓዝ የካርጎ መርከብ ባልታወቀ ነገር ተመታ። የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የባህር ንግድ ኦፕሬሽን እንደገለጸው፣ ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው ከአል ካሳብ 20 የባህር ማይል ርቀት ላይ ነው። ባለሥልጣናት በመርከቧ ላይ ስለደረሰው ጥቃት ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Markabii fe'umsaa tokko naannoo garba Oomaan, Handhuura Hormuzitti imalaa osoo jiruu waan hin beekamneen rukutame. Dhaabbanni Daldala Galaana UK ibsa baaseen, miidhaan kun kan ga'e magaalaa Al-Khaasaab irraa fageenya maayila galaana 20 irratti akka ta'e beeksiseera. Abbootiin taayitaa dhimma miidhaa markabii kanaa irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Iran war live: Tehran denies US talks as Trump warns of ‘last chance’
english: President Donald Trump has claimed that negotiations are currently taking place with Iran, describing these discussions as a final opportunity to resolve the ongoing five-month conflict. However, Iranian officials have officially rejected this statement, clarifying that they are only in dialogue with Oman regarding maritime safety in the Strait of Hormuz. The situation remains tense as both sides present conflicting accounts of potential diplomatic progress.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከአይራን ጋር ድርድር እየተካሄደ መሆኑን በመግለጽ ይህ የአይራን የመጨረሻ ዕድል እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ይህንን የትራምፕ ንግግር ውድቅ በማድረግ ከኦማን ጋር በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ጉዳይ ላይ ብቻ እየተወያዩ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው የዲፕሎማሲያዊ መረጃ ቅራኔ ሁኔታውን የበለጠ አወዛጋቢ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Pireezidaantichi Donald Tiraamp hariiroon dipilomaasii kan Itoophiyaa waliin jalqabamee jiraachuusaa fi kunis carraa xumuraa akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, mootummaan Iraan dubbii kana haaluun, haasa'a kan godhaa jiran biyya Omaan waliin qofa ta'uu fi innis dhimma nagaa gal-gala Hormuz irratti xiyyeeffatu ibseera. Wal-dhabdeen odeeffannoo kun, haala jiru daran muddamaa taasiseera.

title: Two workers who died in quake-hit Japan mall were sent in to get cash
english: A Japanese company named Habita has apologized after two employees died in a shopping mall explosion caused by a massive earthquake. The workers had been ordered by their supervisor to re-enter the damaged building specifically to retrieve cash. The firm acknowledged that this decision directly violated safety evacuation protocols.
amharic: ሃቢታ የተባለ የጃፓን ኩባንያ በኃይለኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ምክንያት በደረሰ የገበያ ማዕከል ፍንዳታ ለሞቱ ሁለት ሠራተኞቹ ይቅርታ ጠይቋል። ሠራተኞቹ ወደ ተጎዳው ሕንፃ እንዲመለሱ የታዘዙት በአለቆቻቸው ትእዛዝ ገንዘብ ለመሰብሰብ ነበር። ኩባንያው ይህ ውሳኔ የደህንነት መመሪያዎችን የጣሰ መሆኑን አምኗል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Jaappan kan 'Habita' jedhamu, hojjettoonni isaa lama kirkira lafaa cimaa booda bakka gabaa tokko keessatti osoo jiranii gubachuu isaaniitiin ergaa gaddaa dabarseera. Hojjettoonni kunneen miidhama irra ga'ee ture keessatti akka deebi'anii maallaqa fudhatan itti gaafatamaan isaanii ajajee ture. Dhaabbatichi gochi kun seera nageenyaa fi bahinsa hatattamaa kan cabse ta'uu isaa amaneera.

title: Death toll from Venezuela earthquakes passes 6,000
english: The Venezuelan government reports that the death toll from two major earthquakes in June has reached 6,125, with over 61,000 people receiving medical care. Officials are facing significant public criticism regarding the slow pace of recovery efforts and the limited removal of debris. Meanwhile, the country is grappling with an estimated $20 billion in damages, leaving the future of the reconstruction process uncertain amid ongoing international sanctions.
amharic: የቬንዙዌላ መንግስት በሰኔ ወር በተከሰቱት ሁለት ከፍተኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጦች የሟቾች ቁጥር 6,125 መድረሱን እና ከ61,000 በላይ ሰዎች በሆስፒታል ህክምና እንደተደረገላቸው አስታውቋል። መንግስት በችግሩ ወቅት ያደረገው ምላሽ አዝጋሚ በመሆኑ እና የፍርስራሽ ማስወገጃ ስራዎች በበቂ ሁኔታ ባለመከናወናቸው ከፍተኛ ትችት እየቀረበበት ነው። አገሪቱ ወደ 20 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመት የንብረት ውድመት የደረሰባት ሲሆን፣ ዓለም አቀፍ ማዕቀቦች ለተሃድሶ ስራው እንቅፋት እንደሆኑ ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Mootummaan Veenzuweelaa socho'a lafaa cimaa ji'a Waxabajjii keessa biyyattii rukutee kanaan namoonni 6,125 du'uu fi namoonni 61,000 ol ta'an hospitaala akka yaalaman beeksiseera. Hojii gargaarsaa fi firaashii qulqulleessuu irratti hanqina mul'ateef mootummaan hoggantoota isaa irratti komiin cimaan ka'aa jira. Miidhaan socho'a lafaa kanaan ga'e tilmaamaan doolaara biiliyoona 20 ga'a; garuu rakkoo dinagdee fi adabbiiwwan biyyoota alaa jiran irraa kan ka'e, deebisanii dhaabuun biyyattii yaaddoo keessa seeneera.

title: Iran's foreign minister denies talks with US
english: Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson has officially rejected claims made by Donald Trump that negotiations between Tehran and Washington were set to begin. The Iranian official clarified that no meetings or direct talks are currently taking place or scheduled. Instead, discussions regarding the Hormuz Strait continue to be handled through mediators from Oman.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ቃል አቀባይ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቴህራን እና በዋሽንግተን መካከል ድርድር ይጀምራል በሚል የተናገሩትን ውድቅ አድርገዋል። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ምንም አይነት ቀጥተኛ ውይይት እንደሌለ እና ምንም አይነት የመገናኘት እቅድ እንዳልተያዘ ገልጸዋል። በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ጉዳዮች ላይ የሚደረጉ ውይይቶች ግን በአማን በኩል መካከለኛ አማላጆችን በመጠቀም እንደሚቀጥሉ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Dubbi himaan ministeera dhimma alaa Iraan, Donald Tiraampii mariin Iraanii fi Ameerikaa gidduutti jalqabuu qaba jedhanii dubbatan dhugaa akka hin taane ibsaniiru. Mootummaan Iraan yeroo ammaa kana mariin kallattii tokko illee akka hin jirre fi karoora wal-arguu kan hin qabne ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru. Haaluma kanaan, mariin dhimma Hormuz Strait irratti taasifamu hundi kan geggeeffamaa jiru giddu galeessummaa biyya Omaaniin ta'uu himaniiru.

title: Iranian plan to attack Ukraine canceled after Kyiv apology
english: A senior Iranian official recently revealed that Tehran had prepared a military strike against Ukraine in retaliation for an alleged attack on an Iranian commercial ship. The planned operation was halted only after Ukraine issued an apology for the incident. This decision prevented a direct military escalation between the two nations.
amharic: ከፍተኛ የኢራን ባለስልጣን እንደገለጹት፣ ኢራን በካስፒያን ባህር ላይ ለደረሰ የንግድ መርከብ ጥቃት ምላሽ ለመስጠት በዩክሬን ላይ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር አቅዳ ነበር። የኢራን ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች ጥቃቱን ለመፈጸም ዝግጅታቸውን አጠናቀው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ ዩክሬን ይቅርታ መጠየቋን ተከትሎ እቅዱ እንዲሰረዝ ተደርጓል። ይህም በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ሊፈጠር የነበረውን ወታደራዊ ግጭት አስቀርቷል።
oromo: Hoggansi olaanaa Iraan tokko akka ibsetti, Iraan doonii daldalaa ishee kan galaana Kaasphiyaan irratti haleelameef deebii kennuuf jecha Yukreen irratti haleellaa raawwachuuf karoorfattee turte. Humnoonni waraana Iraan qophii isaanii xumuranii kan turan ta'us, Yukreen dhiifama waan gaafatteef haleellaan sun haqeera. Tarkaanfiin kunis walitti bu'iinsa waraanaa lamaan gidduutti uumamuu malu dhaabuu danda'eera.

title: Israel revels in Spain's migrant crisis while embarrassing ally Morocco
english: Israeli officials are publicly mocking Spain following a deadly migration surge at the Ceuta border, reportedly as retaliation for Madrid's criticism of Israel’s actions in Gaza. Reports indicate that Morocco opened its border gates, leading to a humanitarian tragedy where dozens of people, including a professional athlete, lost their lives attempting to reach the Spanish enclave. Experts believe Israel is amplifying this crisis to punish Spain for its diplomatic stance against Israeli military policies.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በሰኡታ ድንበር ላይ በደረሰው የፍልሰተኞች ቀውስ ሳቢያ ስፔንን በይፋ እያፌዙባት ሲሆን ይህ ድርጊት ማድሪድ በእስራኤል ላይ ለምትሰነዝረው ትችት የበቀል እርምጃ እንደሆነ ይነገራል። ሞሮኮ የድንበር በሮችን መክፈቷን ተከትሎ በደረሰው አሳዛኝ ክስተት አንዲት ስፖርተኛን ጨምሮ በርካታ ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት እስራኤል ይህንን ቀውስ የምትጠቀምበት ስፔን የፍልስጤምን ጉዳይ በመደገፏ ለመቅጣት ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Israa'el daangaa Se'utaatti rakkoo godaantotaa muudate fayyadamuun Spaanish irratti qoosachaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, kunis tarkaanfii Spaanish Israa'el irratti qeeqxee fudhatteef haaloo bahuudha jedhameera. Marookoon karra daangaa ishee erga bantee booda balaa mudateen ispoortiiwwan tokko dabalatee namoonni hedduun lubbuu isaanii dhabaniiru. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, Israa'el rakkoo kana kan fayyadamtu Spaanish dhimma Falasxiin irratti qabxii ishee jabeessitee fudhatteef adabuufi.

title: Turkish intelligence chief meets Hamas delegation in Istanbul
english: The head of Turkish intelligence, Ibrahim Kalin, held discussions with a Hamas delegation led by Khalil al-Hayya in Istanbul. The talks focused on the latest developments regarding the ongoing conflict in Gaza and the potential for a ceasefire agreement. They also reviewed the impact of recent military escalations in the region.
amharic: የቱርክ የስለላ ድርጅት ኃላፊ ኢብራሂም ካሊን በኢስታንቡል ከሃማስ ልዑካን ቡድን ጋር ተወያይተዋል። በውይይቱ ላይ የጋዛን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ሁለተኛ ምዕራፍ እና በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የእስራኤል ጥቃት በተመለከተ ምክክር ተደርጓል። ይህ ስብሰባ በጋዛ ያለውን ወቅታዊ ሁኔታ ለመገምገም ያለመ ነበር።
oromo: Hogganaan basaasaa biyya Turkii Ibraahim Kaaliin, magaala Istanbulitti garee dhaabbata Hamaas kan Khaliil al-Hayyaan durfamu waliin mari'ataniiru. Mariin kun walii galtee dhaabbii waraana Gazaafi weerara Israa'el kan yeroo dhihoo kana dabalaa dhufe irratti kan xiyyeeffateedha. Gamaaggamni kun haala ammaa Gaza keessa jiru irratti mari'achuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Petrol prices strain US households as oil giants Chevron, Exxon profits soar
english: Major American oil companies like Chevron and ExxonMobil have reported record-breaking profits due to rising global oil prices caused by the war with Iran. While these corporations thrive, low-income US households are facing significant financial pressure, spending over ten percent of their monthly earnings on gasoline. President Donald Trump has publicly criticized the oil giants for their high profits, despite his administration's policies that have supported the industry during these supply chain disruptions.
amharic: እንደ ሼቭሮን እና ኤክሶን ሞቢል ያሉ ትላልቅ የአሜሪካ የነዳጅ ኩባንያዎች ከአሜሪካ-ኢራን ጦርነት ጋር ተያይዞ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በጨመረው የነዳጅ ዋጋ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ትርፍ ማግኘታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። እነዚህ ኩባንያዎች ከፍተኛ ገቢ እያገኙ ቢሆንም፣ ዝቅተኛ ገቢ ያላቸው የአሜሪካ ቤተሰቦች ከወርሃዊ ገቢያቸው ከዐስር በመቶ በላይ ለነዳጅ በማውጣት ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ጫና ውስጥ ወድቀዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የነዳጅ ኩባንያዎቹ የሚያገኙትን ከፍተኛ ትርፍ በይፋ በመተቸት፣ የኩባንያዎቹን ስኬት የአስተዳደራቸው ውጤት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbileen boba'aa gurguddoon Amerikaa kanneen akka Chevron fi ExxonMobil waraana Iran waliin walqabatee gatiin boba'aa addunyaa irraatti dabaluun isaatiin bu'aa guddaa argachuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Dhaabbileen kunniin faayidaa guddaa yeroo argatanitti, maatiin Amerikaa galii gadi aanaa qaban garuu mindaa isaanii keessaa dhibbeentaa kudhanii ol boba'aaf baasuun rakkina dinagdee hamaa keessa jiru. Preezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp dhaabbileen kunniin bu'aa guddaa argachuu isaanii kan komatan yoo ta'u, bu'aan kun dhiibbaa siyaasaa fi deggersa mootummaan isaanii taasisaniin kan dhufe ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: From Trump to El-Sayed: US Arabs in Michigan centre Palestine in politics
english: Arab American voters in Michigan have moved away from the Democratic Party due to dissatisfaction with the handling of the conflict in Gaza. Many community members chose to withhold support for Kamala Harris in the 2024 election as a way to demand accountability for continued military aid to Israel. Despite concerns regarding Donald Trump’s own policies, voters prioritized sending a clear political message over traditional party loyalty.
amharic: በሚቺጋን የሚገኙ የአረብ አሜሪካውያን መራጮች በጋዛ ግጭት አያያዝ ላይ ባላቸው ቅሬታ ምክንያት ከዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ መራቅ ጀምረዋል። ብዙዎቹ የማህበረሰብ ክፍሎች ለእስራኤል እየቀረበ ባለው ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ ላይ ተጠያቂነትን ለማምጣት ሲሉ በ2024 ምርጫ ለካማላ ሃሪስ ድጋፍ ከመስጠት ተቆጥበዋል። የዶናልድ ትራምፕ ፖሊሲዎች አሳሳቢ ቢሆኑም፣ መራጮቹ ለባህላዊ የፓርቲ ታማኝነት ቅድሚያ ከመስጠት ይልቅ ግልጽ የሆነ የፖለቲካ መልእክት ማስተላለፍን መርጠዋል።
oromo: Filattoonni Araba-Amerikaa kan Miishigan keessa jiraatan, waldhabdee Gaazaa irratti adeemsa Paartii Dimokiraatawaa irratti mufachuu isaaniitiin paarticharraa fagaachuu jalqabaniiru. Miseensonni hawaasaa hedduun gargaarsa waraanaa Israa'eliif godhamu irratti gaaffii itti-gaafatamummaa kaasuuf jechuun, filannoo bara 2024 keessa Kaamalaa Haariisii deeggaruu didaniiru. Ilaalchi siyaasaa Doonaald Tiraampis rakkisaa ta'ullee, filattoonni kun amanamummaa paartii aadaa ta'e caalaa, ergaa siyaasaa ifa ta'e dabarsuuf murteessaniiru.

title: Tennis: Philippines’ Eala wins first WTA title, Fritz claims DC crown
english: Alexandra Eala became the first player from the Philippines to secure a WTA Tour singles title after defeating Jessica Pegula at the Mubadala DC Open in a match delayed by rain. Meanwhile, American Taylor Fritz won the men's title by beating teenager Rafael Jodar to claim his first trophy of 2026. These victories mark significant career milestones for both athletes as they prepare for the upcoming US Open.

title: Migrants await asylum in Ceuta amid hunger and thirst
english: Thousands of migrants are currently stranded on a beach in the Spanish territory of Ceuta following a massive border crossing. Many of these individuals are suffering from severe hunger and dehydration while waiting for asylum processing. Local authorities are struggling to provide for the large crowds after the sudden surge in arrivals.

title: Will Israel withdraw from Gaza if Hamas disarms?
english: A proposed U.S.-brokered deal aims to end the conflict in Gaza by having Hamas disarm in exchange for an Israeli military withdrawal and the installation of an international security force. However, both sides are at an impasse, as Israel insists on complete disarmament before moving troops, while Hamas demands a prior Israeli retreat. This fundamental disagreement continues to hinder progress toward a lasting ceasefire.

title: El-Sayed, Stevens face off in Michigan Democratic Senate primary
english: Voters in Michigan are heading to the polls for a competitive Democratic Senate primary featuring Abdul El-Sayed and Haley Stevens. This election is seen as a pivotal moment that could alter the direction of the Democratic Party. Additionally, the results may highlight the changing impact of pro-Israel lobbying efforts within American politics.

Filannoon kun dhimmoota paartii Dimokiraatawaa jijjiiruu danda'an keessaa isa tokko ta'uun isaa ni dubbatama. Kana malees, bu'aan filannoo kanaa dhiibbaa gareewwan Israa'el deggeran uummata keessatti qaban irratti jijjiirama mul'achuu danda'a.

title: Three Palestinians injured in Israeli raid of eastern Nablus
english: Israeli forces raided eastern Nablus on Monday to protect settlers visiting Joseph's tomb, using gunfire and tear gas against local residents. Three Palestinians were injured during the operation, including a teenager shot in the foot, an older man who was assaulted, and a woman who fell. Medical teams provided emergency care to the victims following the confrontation.

title: US reports first two deaths linked to  'explosive diarrhoea' outbreak
english: Health authorities in the United States have confirmed the first two deaths resulting from a widespread cyclosporiasis outbreak caused by a parasite. The infection, which is linked to contaminated lettuce imported from Mexico, has affected thousands of people across 45 states. While officials note that deaths from this illness are rare, they advise the public to thoroughly wash or cook produce to reduce the risk of infection.

title: Hundreds of migrant minors stranded in Ceuta after border crisis
english: Hundreds of unaccompanied migrant children are currently stranded in the Spanish territory of Ceuta after a massive surge of people crossed the border from Morocco. Many of these minors are suffering from hunger and trauma after dangerous journeys that resulted in family separations and deaths. While Spanish law mandates protection for unaccompanied youth, local shelters are overwhelmed, leaving many of these children living on the streets without adequate support.
amharic: በሞሮኮ እና በስፔን ግዛት በሴኡታ መካከል በተፈጠረው የድንበር ቀውስ ሳቢያ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ አጃቢ የሌላቸው ህጻናት ተቸግረዋል። ህጻናቱ አደገኛውን ጉዞ ሲያደርጉ ቤተሰቦቻቸውን በማጣታቸው እና በረሃብ በመሰቃየታቸው ከፍተኛ የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ምንም እንኳን የስፔን ህግ ለእንደዚህ አይነት ህጻናት ጥበቃ ማድረግን የሚያዝ ቢሆንም፣ የመጠለያ ጣቢያዎች አቅም በመሟጠጡ ህጻናቱ በጎዳና ላይ ለመውደቅ ተገደዋል።
oromo: Mudannoo daangaa biyya Morocco fi naannoo Spain kan ta'e Ceuta keessatti uumameen, ijoolleen baqattootaa dhibbaan lakkaa'aman bakka buutota malee rakkachaa jiru. Ijoolleen kun imala hamaa keessa darbuun maatii isaanii dhabuufi beelaan miidhamuun, miidhaa sammuu hamaa keessa jiru. title: Survivors reach port after deadly Indonesia ferry fire
english: Survivors of a tragic ferry fire in Indonesia have arrived at a port as rescue teams continue to look for missing individuals. Authorities report that at least five people died during the incident. Officials also suspect that the boat was carrying more passengers than its official records indicated.

title: Clergy members arrested while protesting at Senate office
english: A group of religious leaders and activists was taken into custody by police while demonstrating at a Senate office building in Washington, D.C. The protesters were demanding a meeting with Senate Majority Leader John Thune to discuss concerns regarding voting rights and the ongoing conflict involving Iran. This demonstration was part of a coordinated '100 Days of Action' campaign leading up to the upcoming national elections.
amharic: የሃይማኖት አባቶች እና አክቲቪስቶች በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ በሚገኝ የሴኔት ቢሮ ተቃውሞ ሲያደርጉ በፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። ተቃዋሚዎቹ የምርጫ መብቶችን እና ከኢራን ጋር ያለውን ግጭት አስመልክቶ ከሴኔቱ አብላጫ ድምፅ መሪ ጆን ትሁን ጋር ለመወያየት ጥረት አድርገው ነበር። ይህ የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ ከመጪው ምርጫ በፊት እየተካሄደ ያለው የ'100 ቀናት የተግባር' ዘመቻ አካል ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni amantii fi sochii hawaasaa kan ta'an gareen tokko magaalaa Waashingitan Diisii keessatti waajjira seeneetii tokko duratti hiriira bahan irratti poolisiin qabamanii jiru. Hiriirtonni kun mirga sagalee kennuu fi waraana Iraan waliin walqabatee dhimmi jiru irratti giddu-galeessa seeneetii keessatti John Thune waliin wal arguuf yaalii godhaniiru. Hiriirri kun kutaalee duula 'Guyyoota 100' kan filannoo biyyoolessaa dura taasifamu keessaa tokko dha.

title: Trump says talks with Iran are ‘last chance’ to forge a deal
english: President Donald Trump has stated that Iran is facing a final opportunity to secure a nuclear agreement, suggesting that discussions could start very soon. However, Iranian officials have rejected these claims, stating that no such negotiations with the United States are currently happening. This creates a clear disagreement between the two nations regarding the status of potential diplomatic efforts.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኢራን የኒውክሌር ስምምነት ለማድረግ የመጨረሻ ዕድል እንደተሰጣት ገልጸው፣ ንግግሮች በቅርብ ቀናት ውስጥ ሊጀምሩ እንደሚችሉ ጠቁመዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በአሁኑ ወቅት ከአሜሪካ ጋር ምንም አይነት ድርድር እየተካሄደ እንዳልሆነ በመግለጽ የፕሬዝዳንቱን ንግግር አስተባብለዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ስለ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቶች አቋም ከፍተኛ ልዩነት እንዳለ ያሳያል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp Iran waliigaltee niukilaraa gochuuf carraa dhumaa akka qabdu ibsuun, mariin guyyoota muraasa keessatti akka jalqabu dubbataniiru. Haa ta'u malee, qondaaltonni Iran gama isaaniitiin mariin akkasii tokko illee ammaan tana Amerikaa waliin akka hin jirre ibsuun himata pirezidaantichaatti deebisaniiru. Kunis hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii fi carraaqqii dippiloomaasii irratti walii galtee dhabuu isaanii kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Drone strike on North Darfur court kills at least 35, rights group says
english: A drone strike allegedly carried out by the Sudanese army on a courthouse in North Darfur killed at least 35 people, including tribal leaders and paramilitary commanders. Human rights monitors and local groups have condemned the attack on the civilian building as a major violation of international law. The strike occurred as part of an intensified military campaign by the Sudanese government to weaken the Rapid Support Forces in the region.
amharic: በሰሜን ዳርፉር በሚገኝ ፍርድ ቤት ላይ በተፈጸመ የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ 35 ሰዎች መሞታቸውን የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ገለጹ። በጥቃቱ ወቅት የጎሳ መሪዎች እና የፈጥኖ ደራሽ ኃይል አባላት የነበሩ ሲሆን፣ የሱዳን ጦር ኃይል ለዚህ ድርጊት ተጠያቂ እንደሆነ ተነግሯል። ዓለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥስ እንደሆነ የተገለጸው ይህ ጥቃት፣ መንግስት በፈጥኖ ደራሽ ኃይሉ ላይ የሚያካሂደውን ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ አካል እንደሆነ ይታመናል።
oromo: Muddee Kibba Darfuuritti mana murti tokko irratti xiyyaara malee (drone) qilleensaa irraa gaggeeffameen namoonni 35 ol ajjeeffamaniiru. Miidhaa kana kan raawwate waraana biyyaalessaa Sudaan akka ta'e kan himame yoo ta'u, du'a kana keessatti hogganoonni gosaa fi miseensonni waraana Rapid Support Forces (RSF) akka argaman ibsameera. Gareewwan mirga namoomaa fi qaamoleen biroon miidhaa mana murtii irratti raawwatame kana balaaleffataniiru.

title: Qatar, Egypt, Turkey condemn Israel over Gaza ceasefire violations
english: Qatar, Egypt, and Turkey have issued a joint statement condemning Israel for continuing military strikes in Gaza despite a ceasefire. These mediating nations argue that targeting civilian infrastructure and healthcare facilities violates international law. They expressed deep concern over the rising number of casualties, particularly among women and children.
amharic: ኳታር፣ ግብፅ እና ቱርክ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ቢኖርም እስራኤል በጋዛ ላይ ጥቃቷን መቀጠሏን በማውገዝ የጋራ መግለጫ አውጥተዋል። እነዚህ አደራዳሪ ሀገራት የእስራኤል የጤና ተቋማትንና መሰረተ ልማቶችን ኢላማ ማድረግ የዓለም አቀፍ ህግ ጥሰት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። በሴቶችና ህጻናት ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን ጉዳት በጥብቅ ተቃውመዋል።
oromo: Qatar, Egyptiifi Turkeen, waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa duraan turus, Israa'el Gazaatti haleellaa itti fufuu ishee balaaleffataniiru. Biyoonni giddu-galeessa ta'anii araaraa jiran kun, Israa'el dhaabbilee fayyaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa irratti haleellaa raawwachuun ishee seera idil-addunyaa cabsuu akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Keessattuu miidhaa dubartootaa fi daa'imman irratti gahaa jiru kana cimsanii balaaleffataniiru.

title: Arab League chief condemns Israeli attacks on Gaza as an attempt to 'sabotage' ceasefire
english: The Arab League secretary general has denounced Israel’s recent military actions in Gaza and the West Bank, claiming these strikes are deliberate efforts to undermine the current ceasefire roadmap. He argued that Israel is attempting to derail withdrawal plans to further expand its occupation. He called for international accountability, insisting that Israel must not succeed in blocking peace efforts for its own political agenda.
amharic: የአረብ ሊግ ዋና ጸሐፊ እስራኤል በጋዛ እና በዌስት ባንክ የምትፈጽመውን ጥቃት አጥብቀው በማውገዝ፣ ይህ ድርጊት የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱን ለማደናቀፍ የታለመ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። እስራኤል ከጋዛ የመውጣት እቅድን ለማክሸፍ እና ወረራዋን ለማስፋፋት እየሰራች መሆኗን የጠቆሙት ዋና ጸሐፊው፣ ይህ አካሄድ ዓለም አቀፍ ተጠያቂነትን የሚጠይቅ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። እስራኤል ለራሷ የውስጥ ጥቅም ስትል የሰላም ጥረቶችን ማጨናገፍ እንደሌለባትም አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan Gamtaa Arabaa haleellaa Israa'el Gazaafi waltajjii Lixaa keessatti raawwattu balaaleeffachuun, gochi kun sagantaa dhaabbii waraanaa cabsuuf kan kaayyeffate ta'uu ibse. Israa'el karoorri gadi-lhiisuu Gazaaf ba'e akka hin milkoofneef jechaa fi weerara ishee bal'ifachuuf dhama'aa jirti jedhe. Hoggantichi, Israa'el haala kanaan carraaqqii nagaa gufachiisuun ishee sirrii miti jechuun, gocha kanaaf itti gaafatamuu akka qabdu akeekkachiiseera.

title: Two Palestinians killed in Israeli strike southwest of Gaza City
english: Two Palestinians were killed and several others sustained injuries during an Israeli drone strike on Monday. The attack occurred when a missile hit a civilian car traveling along a coastal road located southwest of Gaza City. The incident took place near the Sheikh Ajleen neighborhood.
amharic: ሰኞ ዕለት በእስራኤል የድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ ሌሎች በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው ጋዛ ከተማ በስተደቡብ ምዕራብ በሚገኝ የባህር ዳርቻ መንገድ ላይ ሲሆን፣ ኢላማውም በሲቪል መኪና ላይ ነበር። ይህ ክስተት የተከሰተው በሼክ አጅሊን ሰፈር አቅራቢያ ነው።
oromo: Dilbata darbe haleellaa xiyyaara malee namoota Israa'el raawwattee kanaan lammiileen Falasxiin lama ajjeefamanii, kan biroon immoo hedduun madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame magaalaa Gaazaa kibba-lixaa gamtaan karaa qarqara galaanaatti konkolaataa siivilootaa irratti dha. Miidhaan kunis naannoo Sheikh Ajleenitti kan mudatedha.

title: Israeli settlers set fire to Palestinian land south of Nablus
english: Israeli settlers conducted violent attacks against Palestinians in the Nablus region on Monday evening. During these incidents, they burned farmland in Beita and threw stones at vehicles near Burin. Reports indicate that these acts took place while the individuals were being guarded by the Israeli military.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች ሰኞ ምሽት በናብሉስ ደቡባዊ ክፍል በፓለስቲናውያን ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። ጥቃት አድራሾቹ በቤይታ ከተማ የሚገኝ የእርሻ መሬትን በእሳት ያቃጠሉ ሲሆን፣ በቡሪን መንደር አቅራቢያም በተሽከርካሪዎች ላይ ድንጋይ ወርውረዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በእስራኤል ወታደሮች ጥበቃ ታጅበው መፈጸማቸው ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Wiixata galgala, qubattoonni Israa'el naannoo Naablusitti irratti miidhaa qaqqabsisaniiru. Gareen kun lafa qonnaa magaalaa Beeyitaa gubanii fi baandotaa (motora) Burin bira jiran irratti dhagaa darbatuun miidhaa geessisaniiru. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, gochi kun waraana Israa'el biratti eegumsa argatanii kan raawwatame dha.

title: Bomb disposal underway in Le Porge after wildfires unearth WWII shells
english: In Le Porge, France, authorities are currently disposing of unexploded World War II shells found in the area. These dangerous weapons were exposed by recent wildfires that burned through the region. Experts are clearing the site to ensure it is safe for local residents to return to their homes.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ ለ ፖርጅ አካባቢ በቅርቡ በተከሰተው የእሳት ቃጠሎ ምክንያት ከሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት የተረፉ ፈንጂዎች ተጋልጠዋል። ባለሙያዎች አካባቢውን ነዋሪዎች ወደ ቤታቸው ደህንነቱ በተጠበቀ ሁኔታ እንዲመለሱ ለማድረግ የቦምብ ማስወገድ ስራ እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Faransaayi, magaala Le Porge keessatti waraana Addunyaa lammaffaa irraa kan hafan boombiiwwan hin dhoonee turan ibidda bosonaa dhiyeenya kana mudateen booda ifa bahan. Ogeeyyiin boombiiwwan kun akka hin dhoonee fi namoonni nagaan gara mana isaaniitti akka deebi'an qulqulleessuuf hojjechaa jiru.

title: US announces first two deaths from cyclospora outbreak
english: Michigan health authorities have confirmed the first two deaths in the United States linked to a widespread cyclospora parasite outbreak. Both victims suffered from underlying health conditions and severe intestinal distress caused by the infection. Investigators have traced the source of the contamination to lettuce imported from Mexico served at Taco Bell locations, as health officials continue to monitor thousands of confirmed and suspected cases across the country.
amharic: በአሜሪካ ሚቺጋን ግዛት በሳይክሎስፖራ ተውሳክ ወረርሽኝ ምክንያት የመጀመሪያዎቹ ሁለት ሰዎች ህይወት ማለፉን የጤና ባለስልጣናት አስታውቀዋል። የሞቱት ግለሰቦች ቀደም ሲል የጤና እክል የነበረባቸው ሲሆን፣ ኢንፌክሽኑ ያስከተለባቸውን የሆድ ህመም እና የውሃ እጥረት መቋቋም አልቻሉም። የበሽታው ምንጭ ከሜክሲኮ የሚመጣ ሰላጣ መሆኑ ተለይቷል፣ የጤና ባለስልጣናትም በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን እያጠቃ ያለውን ይህንን ወረርሽኝ ለመቆጣጠር ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan naannoo Michigan kan Ameerikaa, dhukkuba 'cyclospora' jedhamuun walqabatee namootni lama du'uu isaanii mirkaneesseera. Namootni kunneen duras dhibee fayyaa kan qaban yoo ta'u, dhibee garaachaa fi qaama keessaa bishaan dhabuun isaan mudateen lubbuun isaanii darbe. Maddi dhibee kanaa salaata (lettuce) biyya Meksikoo irraa dhufee fi nyaata Taco Bell keessatti dhihaatu ta'uun mirkanaa'eera; qaamoleen fayyaas dhibee kana kan qabate namoota kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman to'achuuf hojjechaa jiru.

title: Can Netanyahu survive Israel’s most consequential election?
english: Israel is preparing for its first national election since the war in Gaza began, marking a critical moment for the country. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is struggling to maintain his position due to the fallout from the October 7 attacks, ongoing corruption allegations, and internal conflicts within his government. His political future remains uncertain as he faces significant pressure both domestically and from the international community.
amharic: በጋዛ ጦርነት ከተጀመረ በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የሚካሄደው የእስራኤል አጠቃላይ ምርጫ ለሀገሪቱ ወሳኝ ምዕራፍ ሆኗል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በጥቅምት 7 ጥቃት፣ በሙስና ክሶች እና በመንግስታቸው ውስጥ ባሉ የውስጥ ክፍፍሎች ምክንያት ስልጣናቸውን ለመጠበቅ ከፍተኛ ፈተና ገጥሟቸዋል። በሀገር ውስጥ እና በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ እየደረሰባቸው ባለው ጫና ምክንያት የወደፊት የፖለቲካ ዕጣ ፈንታቸው አጠራጣሪ ሆኗል።
oromo: Israa'el waraana Gaazaatti booda filannoo biyyaalessaa jalqabaa gaggeessuuf qophiirra jirti, kunis biyyattiiuf yeroo murteessaa dha. Muummeen Ministiraa Benyaamiin Netaanyaahuu, haleellaa Sadaasa 7, shakkii malaammaltummaa fi wal dhabdee mootummaa isaanii keessa jiru irraa kan ka'e aangoo isaanii eeggachuu irratti rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru. Dhiibbaa biyya keessaa fi idil-addunyaa irraa isaan mudachaa jiruun, gara fuulduraatti carraan isaanii siyaasa keessatti maal akka ta'u ifaa miti.

title: Israel top court hears challenge to UNRWA ban
english: Israel's Supreme Court is currently reviewing legal petitions against new laws that prohibit the operations of the UN agency for Palestinian refugees, UNRWA. Proponents of the ban claim the move is essential for the country's national security interests. Conversely, human rights groups argue that blocking the organization will severely limit essential aid and services for millions of Palestinians.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት የተባበሩት መንግስታት የፍልስጤም ስደተኞች ድርጅት (UNRWA) በእስራኤል እንዳይሰራ የተከለከለበትን አዋጅ በመቃወም የቀረበውን ክስ እየመረመረ ነው። የህጉ ደጋፊዎች እርምጃው ለሀገሪቱ ብሄራዊ ደህንነት አስፈላጊ ነው ሲሉ ይከራከራሉ። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች በበኩላቸው፣ የድርጅቱ መታገድ በሚሊዮን ለሚቆጠሩ ፍልስጤማውያን የሚደረገውን አስፈላጊ እርዳታ እና አገልግሎት አደጋ ላይ ይጥላል ሲሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Mana maree olaanaa kan Israa'el dhaabbata gargaarsa baqattoota Filisxeemii (UNRWA) biyyattii keessatti hojii irraa dhorkuun seeraan alaa jechuun himannaa dhiyaate qorachaa jira. Deggeroonni seera kanaa tarkaanfiin kun nageenya biyyaaf murteessaa dha jedhu. Gama biraatiin, gareewwan mirga namoomaa dhaabbatichi hojii isaa dhaabuun gargaarsa bu'uuraa fi tajaajila miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman irratti miidha guddaa akka qaqqabsiisu ibsanii jiru.

title: Drone slams into Russian beach, killing at least 7 people
english: A drone strike on a crowded beach near the Russian resort of Gelendzhik has resulted in the deaths of at least seven individuals, including three children. Dozens more people were injured in the incident, which Moscow claims was carried out by Ukraine. While it remains uncertain whether the drone was targeting a nearby naval facility or was hit by defenses, Ukrainian officials have not yet addressed the accusations.
amharic: በሩሲያ ጌሌንጂክ የባህር ዳርቻ በተፈጸመ የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሰባት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ከነዚህም መካከል ሶስት ህጻናት ይገኙበታል። በወቅቱ በነበረው ጥቃት ሌሎች በርካታ ሰዎች የቆሰሉ ሲሆን ሞስኮ ጥቃቱን የፈጸመችው ዩክሬን እንደሆነች ከሰሳለች። ድሮኑ በቅርበት በሚገኘው የባህር ኃይል ጣቢያ ላይ ያነጣጠረ እንደሆነ ወይም በመከላከያ ስርዓት የተመታ እንደሆነ እስካሁን አልታወቀም፤ ዩክሬንም እስካሁን በጉዳዩ ላይ አስተያየት አልሰጠችም።
oromo: Naannoo boqonnaa biyya Raashiyaa Gelendzhik jedhamutti bakka namoonni baay'een jiranitti xiyyaaraan daandii malee balali'u (drone) miidhaa geessiseen namoonni yoo xiqqaate torba du'aniiru; isaan keessas daa'imman sadii ni argamu. Miidhaa kanaan namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman kan madaa'an yoo ta'u, mootummaan Raashiyaa haleellaa kana kan raawwate Yukreen akka ta'e himateera. Xiyyaaran kun buufata waraana galaanaa itti dhihoo jiru kan karoorfatee ture ykn qilleensa irraa kan rukutame ta'uun ammas ifa miti; mootummaan Yukreenis hanga ammaatti waa'ee haleellaa kanaa homaa hin jenne.

title: Russia says seven killed and 40 injured by Ukrainian drone hitting busy beach
english: A Ukrainian drone strike on a crowded beach in Russia's Krasnodar region resulted in the deaths of seven people, including three children, and injured 40 others. While Russian officials condemned the incident as a direct attack on civilians, some reports suggest the drone may have crashed due to electronic jamming or defensive fire. Ukraine has not yet issued a comment regarding the event, which occurred at a popular seaside tourist destination.
amharic: በሩሲያ ክራስኖዳር ክልል በሚገኝ ተወዳጅ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ በደረሰ የዩክሬን ድሮን ጥቃት ሰባት ሰዎች መሞታቸውንና 40 ሰዎች መቁሰላቸውን ባለስልጣናት አስታወቁ። ከሟቾቹ መካከል ሶስት ህጻናት የሚገኙበት ሲሆን የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት ጥቃቱ ሆን ተብሎ በሲቪል ነዋሪዎች ላይ የተፈጸመ ነው ሲሉ ከሰዋል። ሆኖም አንዳንድ መረጃዎች ድሮኑ የተኩስ አድማስ መከላከያ ስርአቶች ወይም የኤሌክትሮኒክ የጦርነት መሳሪያዎች ጣልቃ ገብነት ምክንያት ሊሆን እንደሚችል ይጠቁማሉ፤ ዩክሬን እስካሁን በጉዳዩ ላይ ምንም አይነት አስተያየት አልሰጠችም።
oromo: Naannoo Krasnodaar kan Raashiyaa keessatti bakka boqonnaa namoonni itti fayyadaman tokko irratti xiyyaarri malee (drone) Yukreen irraa dhufte kuftee namoota torba ajjeesteetti, isaan keessaa sadii ijoollee dha. Namoonni 40 kan ta'an miidhamaniiru. Aangooti Raashiyaa miidhaa kana haleellaa qamaa nagaa irratti xiyyeeffate jechuun balaaleffatan; garuu gabaasni tokko tokko xiyyaarittiin sun sababa meeshaa waraanaatiin ykn ittisa qilleensaa kuffifamuu dandeessi jedhu. Yukreen hanga ammaatti waa'ee haleellaa kanaa ibsa hin kennine.

title: Republicans say they will back Blanche after US Justice Department order
english: Two Republican senators have agreed to support Todd Blanche's nomination for Attorney General after he officially cancelled a contentious $1.8 billion fund. This fund had faced bipartisan backlash due to concerns that taxpayer money might be used to compensate political allies of President Trump, including those involved in the January 6 Capitol attack. With this cancellation, the senators are now prepared to help advance his nomination through the Senate Judiciary Committee.
amharic: ሁለት የሪፐብሊካን ሴናተሮች ቶድ ብላንች አወዛጋቢውን የ1.8 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ፈንድ መሰረዛቸውን ተከትሎ ለጠቅላይ አቃቤ ህግነት የሚደረገውን እጩነታቸውን ለመደገፍ ተስማምተዋል። ይህ ፈንድ የመንግስት ገንዘብ ለፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የፖለቲካ አጋሮች ሊውል ይችላል በሚል ስጋት በሁለቱም ወገኖች ተቃውሞ ገጥሞት ነበር። አሁን ፈንዱ በመሰረዙ ሴናተሮቹ የእጩነቱን ሂደት በሴኔቱ የፍትህ ኮሚቴ በኩል ለማራመድ ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Senatoorri Ripabilikaan lama Todd Blanche muudama isaanii kan gara fuulduraa irratti deggeruuf walii galan, kunis booda kan ta'e erga maallaqa wal-falchiisaa biiliyoona 1.8 ta'u haqanii booda dha. Maallaqni kun qarshii gibira kaffaltotaa fayyadamuudhaan degertoota Pirezidaant Traampii fi warra haleellaa ganda Kaappitol irraatti hirmaatan fayyaduu danda'a jedhamee waan shakkameef mormii guddaa mudatee ture. Maallaqni kun haqamuu isaatiin, senatooroonni kun muudamni isaanii komitee seeraa senatii keessa akka darbu deggersa kennuuf murteessaniiru.

title: Trump blasts ‘duplicitous’ Iran after Tehran denies it is in talks with the US
english: President Donald Trump has criticized Iran for being dishonest after Tehran denied engaging in direct negotiations with the United States. Trump stated he will maintain a strict naval blockade, which he calls a 'Wall of Steel,' in the Strait of Hormuz until Iran agrees to a deal or surrenders. While Trump paused a planned massive military strike to allow for potential diplomacy, Iran maintains it is only discussing regional navigation routes with third parties like Oman.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኢራን ከአሜሪካ ጋር ቀጥተኛ ድርድር እያደረግኩ አይደለም ማለቷን ተከትሎ አገሪቱን በሐሰተኛነት ከሰሷታል። የሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ላይ የጣሉትን የባህር ላይ ማገጃ ወይም 'የብረት ግድግዳ' እስኪስማሙ ወይም እጅ እስኪሰጡ ድረስ እንደማያነሱት አስታውቀዋል። ትራምፕ ለዲፕሎማሲ እድል ለመስጠት ታቅዶ የነበረውን መጠነ ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ለጊዜው ያዘገዩት ቢሆንም፣ ኢራን በአሁኑ ወቅት ከኦማን ጋር ብቻ በባህር ጉዞ ደህንነት ዙሪያ እየተወያየች እንደሆነ ትገልጻለች።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Doolaard Traamp, Iraan marii kallattiin Ameerikaa waliin gochaa akka hin jirre ibsuu ishee hordofee, mootummaan Iraan gowwoomsaa akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Traamp, hamma Iraan waliigaltee irra geessutti ykn harka kennattutti, daandii galaana Hormuz irratti uggura 'Dhaabbata Sibilaa' jedhamu akka itti fufan ibsaniiru. Traamp haleellaa waraanaa guddaa karoorfatanii turan dippiloomaasiif jecha kan dhaaban ta'us, Iraan gama ishiitiin mariin isaanii biyyoota sadaffaa kanneen akka Omaanii waliin daandii galaana qulqulleessuu irratti qofa ta'uu ibsiteetti.

title: New illegal Israeli outpost spotted in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli settlers have begun constructing a new unauthorized outpost situated between three Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank. This development follows a recent surge in such outposts across the region after a violent incident involving both Israelis and Palestinians. Local sources report that these activities are expanding tensions within the area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ውስጥ በሶስት የፍልስጤም መንደሮች መካከል አዲስ ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራ መገንባት መጀመራቸው ተዘግቧል። ይህ ድርጊት የተፈፀመው በእስራኤላውያን እና በፍልስጤማውያን መካከል ከተከሰተው ግጭት በኋላ በአካባቢው ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራዎች እየጨመሩ በመጡበት ወቅት ነው። በአካባቢው የሚኖሩ ነዋሪዎች ይህ መስፋፋት ውጥረትን እያባባሰ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Qotee bulaan Israa'el naannoo Qaxxaamuraa Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti baadiyyaalee Falasxiin sadii gidduutti buufata haaraa seeraan alaa ijaaruu jalqabaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe walitti bu'iinsa Israa'elotaa fi Falasxiinotaa gidduutti gaggeeffame booda, buufataaleen akkanaa naannichatti babal'achaa jiranii dha. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, ijaarsi kun naannichatti waldhabdee fi tasgabbii dhabuu dabalaa jira.

title: Uncertainty on Iranians’ minds as Trump fluctuates on war and talk
english: Iranians are experiencing significant anxiety and uncertainty due to President Donald Trump's inconsistent statements regarding potential military conflict and diplomatic talks. Many citizens are choosing to ignore the constant news cycle to protect their mental health, while others are frustrated by the volatile political environment. Meanwhile, the country continues to face severe economic challenges, characterized by a rapidly weakening national currency.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ በሚያደርጉት የተቃራኒ መግለጫዎች ምክንያት የኢራን ህዝብ ከፍተኛ የሆነ ስጋትና እርግጠኛ አለመሆን ውስጥ ገብቷል። ብዙ ዜጎች የአእምሮ ሰላማቸውን ለመጠበቅ ሲሉ የዜና ማሰራጫዎችን ከመከታተል እየተቆጠቡ ሲሆን፣ ሌሎች ደግሞ በሀገሪቱ ወቅታዊ ሁኔታ ላይ ከፍተኛ ቅር ተሰኝተዋል። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ፣ የሀገሪቱ ገንዘብ የመግዛት አቅም በከፍተኛ ደረጃ በመቀነሱ ኢኮኖሚው አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ላይ ይገኛል።

title: Inside the Palestine Action protests
english: The British government has officially designated the protest group Palestine Action as a terrorist organization following their recent demonstrations. This legal shift has led to mass arrests and ongoing police investigations for many involved in the movement. Despite these strict measures, supporters continue to advocate for their cause, with some activists expressing a willingness to face jail time to protest the humanitarian crisis in Gaza.

title: Rhine falls to record low levels as drought strains Europe's rivers
english: Persistent heatwaves across Europe have caused the Rhine and other major rivers to drop to historic low levels, threatening vital shipping and industrial routes. Authorities are concerned that these shallow waters will force cargo vessels to carry lighter loads, leading to increased transport costs and potential supply shortages. With drought conditions expected to continue, these waterways are facing significant strain that impacts both energy production and the broader economy.

title: Threat to oil tankers in Middle East  worst since start of Iran war, analysts say
english: Experts warn that oil tanker security in the Middle East has reached its most dangerous point since the conflict with Iran began. As the vital Strait of Hormuz remains largely blocked, recent attacks by Houthi rebels on alternative Red Sea routes have further crippled global energy shipping. This dual threat has created a severe, compounding crisis for the international oil trade and maritime security.

title: Russian anti-war politician says he has fled the country
english: Russian politician Boris Nadezhdin has announced he fled to France after the Russian government labeled him a foreign agent. Previously known for his anti-war presidential bid, Nadezhdin faced legal accusations and was blocked from participating in upcoming parliamentary elections. He is now residing in Paris while he determines his next steps for his political future.

title: Iraqi Kurdish regional leader meets Syrian president in Damascus
english: The President of Iraq’s Kurdistan region, Nechirvan Barzani, recently traveled to Damascus to meet with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa. This historic visit marks the first time a Kurdish leader has met with the new Syrian administration to discuss stabilizing regional ties and economic cooperation. A primary goal of the talks is to find a path for integrating the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) into the national military while ensuring constitutional rights and autonomy for Kurds in post-Assad Syria.

oromo: Pirezidaantii naannoo Kurdistaan kan Iraaq, Nechirvan Barzani, dhimmoota biyyaalessaa irratti mari’achuuf gara Damasqoos imaluun Pirezidaantii Siiriyaa Ahimad al-Sharaa wal arganiiru. Mariin isaanii kun hariiroo dinagdee fi siyaasaa jidduu isaanii jiru cimsuu fi humnoonni SDF hiriira waraana biyyaalessaa keessatti akka hammataaman irratti xiyyeeffata. Akkasumas, sirna Siiriyaa haaraa keessatti mirgoota heeraa fi of-danda’uu saboota Kurdii mirkaneessuuf mari’ataniiru.

title: Romanian navy blasts riverbed to protect nuclear plant
english: The Romanian navy has used explosives to clear a portion of the Danube riverbed to ensure a steady water supply for the Cernavoda Nuclear Power Plant. This action was taken because severe heat and drought caused river water levels to drop to historic lows. By deepening the channel, authorities aim to prevent potential operational issues at the facility.

title: Indian court acquits ex-wrestling chief in sexual harassment case
english: A New Delhi court has cleared the former head of India's wrestling federation, Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh, of sexual harassment and stalking charges brought by several female athletes. The judge cited inconsistencies in witness testimonies as the reason for the acquittal, though the accused politician has long denied any wrongdoing. The female wrestlers who filed the case expressed their dissatisfaction with the ruling and have vowed to challenge the decision in a higher court.
